text.price: $2,003 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are about 15% above similar developments in District 16.
text.record: Prices rose 14% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 15% for developments with similar features in District 16 — about the same as similar developments.

text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are about 15% above similar developments in District 16.
